stories.title: A Job in the Garden
l1: My friend Ana and I went to the school garden on Monday.
First, we pulled the weeds by the fence.
I felt happy to be outside.
Next, we filled two cans with water.
Then, we gave water to every bean plant.
l2: My friend Ana and I went to the school garden on Monday.
By the fence, the ground was dry and hard.
First, we pulled the weeds by the fence.
After that, we filled two cans with water.
I wondered if the beans were thirsty.
Later, we gave water to every bean plant.

end.right: Soon, the bell rang, and we put the cans in the shed.
end.newEvent: At the end, a big dog ran into the garden.
end.again: On Monday, Ana and I went out to the school garden.

stories.title: A Sun and a House
l1: My friend Omar and I took a box of chalk outside at recess.
First, we drew a big sun on the blacktop.
I was happy to see the bright colors.
Next, we drew a house under the sun.
Then, we wrote our names in blue.
l2: My friend Omar and I took a box of chalk outside at recess.
First, we drew a big sun on the blacktop.
I wondered if we had enough chalk.
Next, we drew a house under the sun.
In the box, every piece was a new color.
Finally, we wrote our names in blue.

end.right: Before the whistle blew, we put the chalk away.
end.newEvent: After that, a girl asked us to jump rope on the blacktop.
end.again: Omar and I went out to the blacktop with chalk at recess.

stories.title: Four Tall Towers
l1: Mei and I built a castle with blocks in class on Friday.
First, we made four tall towers.
I was so excited to see it grow.
Next, we put a long block on top for a bridge.
Then, we set a paper flag on the highest tower.
l2: Mei and I built a castle with blocks in class on Friday.
On the rug, we used every block in the box.
First, we made four tall towers.
After that, we put a long block on top for a bridge.
I hoped the bridge would not fall.
Later, we set a paper flag on the highest tower.

end.right: At cleanup time, we put every block back on the shelf.
end.newEvent: At cleanup time, we started to build a second castle.
end.again: On Friday, Mei and I made a block castle in our class.

stories.title: Thumbs in the Middle
l1: My class made clay bowls in art on Tuesday.
I was so excited to make my own bowl.
First, I rolled my clay into a ball.
Next, I pushed my thumbs into the middle.
Then, I pinched the sides to make them thin.
l2: My class made clay bowls in art on Tuesday.
On my table, there was a lump of gray clay.
First, I rolled my clay into a ball.
I wondered what color I would paint it.
Next, I pushed my thumbs into the middle.
Later, I pinched the sides to make them thin.

end.right: At the end of art, I set my bowl on the shelf to dry.
end.newEvent: At the end of art, I started to make a clay snake.
end.again: On Tuesday, my class made bowls out of clay in art.

stories.title: A Slow Beat and a Fast Beat
l1: My class played drums in music class on Wednesday.
First, our teacher gave each of us a small drum.
Next, we tapped a slow beat with our hands.
I felt calm and happy.
Then, we played a fast beat with sticks.
l2: My class played drums in music class on Wednesday.
First, our teacher gave each of us a small drum.
On top, my drum was red.
Next, we tapped a slow beat with our hands.
I wondered how loud we could get.
After that, we played a fast beat with sticks.

end.right: When music was over, we put the drums away.
end.newEvent: When the fast beat ended, we started to learn a new song.
end.again: My class played drums on Wednesday.

stories.title: Pass the Baton
l1: My class ran a relay race in the gym on Thursday.
First, our teacher put us in two teams.
I was nervous about my turn.
Next, I ran fast to the cone and back.
Then, I passed the baton to my friend Leila.
l2: My class ran a relay race in the gym on Thursday.
First, our teacher put us in two teams.
On each team, one runner held a red baton.
I hoped our team would be fast.
Next, I ran fast to the cone and back.
After that, I passed the baton to my friend Leila.

end.right: After the race, both teams sat down to rest.
end.newEvent: Before we went back to class, we started a game of tag.
end.again: My class had a race in the gym on Thursday.

stories.title: A Green Cover
l1: My class went to the school library on Monday.
I was so glad it was library day.
First, I looked at the books about frogs.
Next, I picked one with a green cover.
Then, I sat on a beanbag to read it.
l2: My class went to the school library on Monday.
First, I looked at the books about frogs.
Next, I picked one with a green cover.
I thought the frog on the front looked silly.
Later, I sat on a beanbag to read it.
Up close, the beanbag was soft and squishy.

end.right: When library time was over, I checked out my frog book.
end.newEvent: At the end, a big box of new books came to the library.
end.again: On Monday, my class went to the library.

stories.title: Dip and Blow
l1: My friend Theo and I blew bubbles at recess on Friday.
First, we dipped our wands in the soap.
I was happy and silly.
Next, we blew a long line of tiny bubbles.
Then, we ran to catch them in the air.
l2: My friend Theo and I blew bubbles at recess on Friday.
Outside, the wind was soft and warm.
First, we dipped our wands in the soap.
I wondered how many bubbles I could make.
After that, we blew a long line of tiny bubbles.
Later, we ran to catch them in the air.

end.right: By the end of recess, we put the wands back in the jar.
end.newEvent: After that, Theo and I started a game of catch.
end.again: On Friday, Theo and I went out to blow bubbles at recess.

stories.title: Up, Up, Up
l1: My grandma and I went to the park on Sunday.
I was so excited to fly a kite.
First, we unrolled the kite string.
Next, Grandma held the kite up high.
Then, I ran across the grass, and the kite went up.
l2: My grandma and I went to the park on Sunday.
First, we unrolled the kite string.
Next, Grandma held the kite up high.
I wondered if it would fly.
Finally, I ran across the grass, and the kite went up.
Up in the sky, its long yellow tail waved.

end.right: When the wind stopped, we rolled up the string.
end.newEvent: When the kite came down, a boy asked us to play ball.
end.again: On Sunday, I went to the park with my grandma.

stories.title: Faces on Bags
l1: My friend Nadia and I made a puppet show in class on Monday.
First, we drew two faces on paper bags.
Next, we hid behind a table and held up the puppets.
I was a little shy.
Then, our puppets told a joke to the class.
l2: My friend Nadia and I made a puppet show in class on Monday.
First, we drew two faces on paper bags.
On my puppet, the nose was big and orange.
After that, we hid behind a table and held up the puppets.
I hoped everyone would get the joke.
Later, our puppets told a joke to the class.

end.right: After everyone clapped, we took a bow and sat down.
end.newEvent: At the end, Nadia started to draw a third puppet.
end.again: On Monday, Nadia and I made puppets in our class.

stories.title: A Star Where I Sit
l1: My class drew maps of our classroom on Wednesday.
I was excited to use a ruler.
First, I drew a big square for the room.
Next, I added small boxes for the desks.
Then, I drew a star by my seat.
l2: My class drew maps of our classroom on Wednesday.
For the lines, I used a ruler and a sharp pencil.
First, I drew a big square for the room.
I thought it looked like a box from the top.
After that, I added small boxes for the desks.
Finally, I drew a star by my seat.

end.right: At the end of the day, I hung my map by the door.
end.newEvent: After that, my friend and I started a new map of the gym.
end.again: On Wednesday, my class made maps of the classroom.

stories.title: Red and Blue
l1: My class played a beanbag game in the gym on Friday.
First, we set three hoops on the floor.
Next, I tossed a beanbag into the red hoop.
I felt excited to see it land.
Then, I tossed one into the blue hoop.
l2: My class played a beanbag game in the gym on Friday.
On each beanbag, there was a frog face.
First, we set three hoops on the floor.
I thought the green hoop looked too far away.
Next, I tossed a beanbag into the red hoop.
After that, I tossed one into the blue hoop.

end.right: Once the game was over, we put the beanbags away.
end.newEvent: When we were done, our teacher showed us a game with balls.
end.again: On Friday, my class played a game with beanbags in the gym.

stories.title: Under the Sand
l1: My friend Kai and I played in the sandbox at the park on Saturday.
I was so excited to dig.
First, we dug a deep hole with a cup.
Next, we made a tunnel under the sand.
Then, we poured water down the tunnel.
l2: My friend Kai and I played in the sandbox at the park on Saturday.
First, we dug a deep hole with a cup.
Down in the hole, the sand was wet and cold.
Next, we made a tunnel under the sand.
I wondered if water would go through it.
After that, we poured water down the tunnel.

end.right: Before we went home, we filled the hole back up.
end.newEvent: After that, a little boy brought a red truck to the sandbox.
end.again: On Saturday, Kai and I went to the sandbox at the park.

stories.title: Every Color
l1: My class took a walk around the school yard on Tuesday.
First, we looked for leaves of every color.
Next, I picked up a red leaf and a yellow leaf.
I was glad I found a big one.
Then, we put our leaves in a paper bag.
l2: My class took a walk around the school yard on Tuesday.
First, we looked for leaves of every color.
I wondered how many leaves we would find.
Next, I picked up a red leaf and a yellow leaf.
Later, we put our leaves in a paper bag.
In my hands, the bag got heavy and full.

end.right: At the end of the walk, we carried our full bag inside.
end.newEvent: When we got back to class, we saw a bird building a nest.
end.again: On Tuesday, my class walked around the school yard.

stories.title: Wavy Blue Lines
stories.topic: painting the sea at the easel
l1: I painted a picture of the sea at the easel on Thursday.
I was excited to paint.
First, I painted wavy blue lines.
Next, I added a yellow boat on the waves.
Then, I made white dots for the splash.
l2: I painted a picture of the sea at the easel on Thursday.
First, I painted wavy blue lines.
Next, I added a yellow boat on the waves.
I wondered if the boat needed a sail.
After that, I made white dots for the splash.
On the paper, the paint was wet and shiny.

end.right: When the paint was dry, I took it home to show my family.
end.newEvent: Before I washed my brush, I started to paint a red fish.
end.again: On Thursday, I made a sea picture at the easel.

stories.title: One Foot
l1: My friend Rosa and I played hopscotch at recess on Monday.
First, I tossed a small stone onto square one.
Next, I hopped on one foot to the end.
I felt so happy that I did not fall.
Then, I hopped back and picked up my stone.
l2: My friend Rosa and I played hopscotch at recess on Monday.
With pink chalk, Rosa drew the squares.
First, I tossed a small stone onto square one.
Next, I hopped on one foot to the end.
I thought I might tip over.
Later, I hopped back and picked up my stone.

end.right: As the bell rang, I put my stone by the wall.
end.newEvent: When I was done, Rosa started a new game of tag.
end.again: On Monday, Rosa and I went to play hopscotch at recess.

ideas.idea: A time I helped a friend

draft2.beginning: On Monday, Dev's crayons fell all over the rug.
draft2.middle: First, I picked them up. Next, we sorted the colors. Last, he put them in his box.
draft2.ending: At the end, Dev said thanks, and I felt glad I helped.

ideas.idea: A time I tried something new

draft2.beginning: On Monday, I tried the monkey bars with my friend Zoe.
draft2.middle: First, I climbed the ladder. Next, I grabbed the cold bars. Last, I swung across.
draft2.ending: At the end, Zoe clapped, and I felt so brave.

ideas.idea: A time I was surprised at school

draft1.beginning: a firefighter came to our school as a surprise.

draft2.beginning: On Friday, a firefighter came to our school as a surprise.
draft2.middle: First, we saw his red truck. Next, I tried on his helmet. Last, we waved goodbye.
draft2.ending: At the end, I felt happy and excited.

ideas.idea: A time something went wrong and I fixed it

plan.first: saw a rip in my art

draft2.beginning: On Tuesday, my drawing of a cat ripped in art class.
draft2.middle: First, I got some clear tape. Next, I turned it over. Last, I taped the rip shut.
draft2.ending: At the end, my drawing was fixed, and I felt proud.

draft2.beginning: On a rainy Wednesday, Ben, Lin, and I had recess inside.
draft2.middle: First, we found a puzzle of a ship. Next, we sorted the edges. Last, we finished it.
draft2.ending: At the end, we put the puzzle away, and I felt happy.

ideas.idea: My first day of second grade
ideas.topic: the first day of second grade

plan.last: sat with Ava on the rug

draft1.beginning: it was my first day of second grade.

draft2.beginning: On Monday, I walked into my second grade class.
draft2.middle: First, I found my desk. Next, we played a name game. Last, I sat with Ava on the rug.
draft2.ending: At the end, I was not nervous anymore.

exampleIdeas.idea: Making a paper chain for our door
exampleIdeas.model: On Friday, my friend Lena and I made a paper chain. First, we cut red and gold strips. Next, we glued them into rings. Last, we hung it on our door. At the end, I felt so proud of it.

revise.added: It went across the whole door.
revise.fixed: We hung it on the door.

exampleIdeas.model: On Thursday, Jonah and I made paper airplanes in the gym. First, we folded our planes. Next, we drew stripes on them. Last, we tossed them across the gym. At the end, I felt excited.
On Monday, my class let our butterflies go in the school yard. First, we carried the net outside. Next, we opened the top. Last, we watched them fly away. At the end, I felt a little sad.

exampleIdeas.idea: Painting rocks for the school garden
exampleIdeas.model: On Wednesday, Iris and I painted rocks in the art room. First, we washed two rocks. Next, we painted them blue. Last, we set them by the plants. At the end, I felt happy.

revise.asked: What did you paint on them?

details.plain: I made a mask in art.
details.added: It was a lion with a yellow mane.
I felt shy, but I sang anyway.

details.plain: We did a dance in music.
details.added: We clapped and spun in a circle.

details.plain: I read a book about sharks.
details.added: Sharks have many rows of teeth.

details.plain: I saw an ant on the sidewalk.

details.added: It was purple with tiny wings.

details.plain: We counted the windows in our school.
My class made a big poster.
I heard a loud noise in the hall.
We played a game in gym.
I wrote a letter to my grandpa.
details.added: I told him about my soccer goal.

details.plain: We looked at bugs with a magnifying glass.
details.added: I saw tiny hairs on a fly.

details.plain: I made a card for my teacher.
details.added: It had a big purple flower.

details.plain: I built a cup tower in math.
details.added: It was as tall as my desk.
We stood like trees on one foot.

details.plain: I saw a rabbit by the fence.

editStories.title: Soccer at Recess
editStories.name: Kofi
sents: My friend Kofi and I played soccer at recess.
First, we picked teams on the grass.
Next, I kicked the ball down the field.
Then, the ball rolled into the net.
Everyone on my team gave a big cheer.
At the end of recess, we lined up by the door.

editStories.title: Tug-of-War
editStories.name: Malik
sents: My class played tug-of-war in gym.
First, our teacher tied a red flag on the rope.
Next, we held the rope with both hands.
Then, we pulled as hard as we could.
My friend Malik pulled the flag over the line.
At the end, we all sat down to rest.
editStories.off: The moon is very far away.

editStories.title: Our Box Robot
editStories.name: Nia
sents: My friend and I made a robot out of boxes.
First, we taped two boxes together.
Next, we cut holes for the arms.
Then, we glued on bottle caps for eyes.
My friend Nia said it was taller than my desk.
At the end of the day, we showed it to the class.

editStories.title: The Fish Mural
editStories.name: Sami
sents: My class painted a big mural for the hall.
First, we drew fish with a pencil.
Next, we painted them orange and blue.
Then, my friend Sami added green plants.
Our teacher hung the mural in the hall.
At the end, the whole class looked at it.

editStories.title: Our Class Play
editStories.name: Ari
sents: My friend Ari and I practiced our class play.
First, we put on our animal hats.
Next, we said our lines on the stage.
Then, we sang our song together.
Our teacher said we did a good job.
At the end, we took off our hats.

editStories.title: The Three-Legged Race
editStories.name: Gabe
sents: I ran a three-legged race in gym.
First, our teacher tied my leg to a friend's leg.
Next, my friend Gabe and I walked to the start.
Then, we hopped and ran to the cone.
We fell one time, but we got right up.
At the end, we crossed the finish line.

editStories.title: Pinwheels
editStories.name: Hana
sents: My friend Hana and I made pinwheels in art.
First, we cut a square of paper.
Next, we folded the corners to the middle.
Then, our teacher put a pin in the center.
We blew on them to make them spin.
At the end of art, we took them home.

editStories.title: Playing Catch
editStories.name: Wes
sents: My friend and I played catch at the park.
First, we stood far apart on the grass.
Next, I threw the ball high in the air.
Then, my friend Wes caught it with one hand.
We threw it back and forth ten times.
At the end, we sat on a bench to rest.
editStories.off: The sun is a big star.

editStories.title: The Reading Tent
editStories.name: Lila
sents: My friend and I read in the class tent.
First, we picked two books about space.
Next, we crawled inside the tent.
Then, Lila and I took turns reading out loud.
We used a flashlight to see the pages.
At the end, we put the books back.

editStories.title: Paper Snowflakes
editStories.name: Tariq
sents: My class made paper snowflakes.
First, we folded white paper into a triangle.
Next, we cut small shapes on the sides.
Then, we opened the paper very slowly.
My friend Tariq held his up to the window.
At the end, we hung them on the wall.
editStories.off: Ducks like to swim in ponds.

editStories.title: Two Points
editStories.name: Ravi
sents: My friend Ravi and I played basketball in gym.
First, we bounced the ball to warm up.
Next, I took a shot at the hoop.
Then, the ball went right in.
Our team got two points.
At the end of gym, we put the balls away.

editStories.title: The Sparkly Rock
editStories.name: Ayla
sents: I hunted for rocks at recess.
First, I looked by the big tree.
Next, my friend Ayla found a rock with sparkles.
Then, we washed it in a cup of water.
We put it in our class rock box.
At the end of recess, we went back inside.
editStories.off: Many owls sleep during the day.

editStories.title: Sorting Buttons
editStories.name: Noah
sents: My friend Noah and I sorted buttons in math.
First, we dumped the buttons on the table.
Next, we made a pile for each color.
Then, we counted the buttons in each pile.
The red pile had the most buttons.
At the end, we put them back in the jar.

editStories.title: Three Dance Moves
editStories.name: Ines
sents: My class made up dances in music.
First, we picked a fast song.
Next, we made up three moves.
Then, we showed our dance to the class.
My friend Ines clapped along with us.
At the end, we took a bow.

editStories.title: Our Faces
editStories.name: Mateo
sents: My friend and I drew our faces in art.
First, we looked in a small mirror.
Next, we drew the shape of our heads.
Then, my friend Mateo drew a big smile.
I made my hair curly and brown.
At the end, we hung the pictures on the wall.

editStories.title: The Straw Bridge
editStories.name: Lucia
sents: I built a bridge in science.
First, I taped straws into triangles.
Next, my friend Lucia joined them in a row.
Then, we set our bridge across two books.
It held ten pennies before it bent.
At the end, we wrote how many it held.
